title: Afterpiece (bc30)
synopsis: Owen, once a celebrated stage director, has spent more than a decade lost in creative paralysis. In an attempt to revive his reputation, he sets out to produce a new play, casting a completely unknown female lead, to whom he is increasingly drawn. However, the sudden appearance of his former movie-star lover sets off a chain of events that blurs the boundary between performance and reality. The debut directorial feature by Keane Wong presents a compelling play within a play, inviting the audience to ponder the humanity in struggle infused with profound emotional depth and conflict.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 一位曾經風光無限的舞台劇導演，陷入長達十餘年靈感枯竭的低谷。昔日愛人以舊情介入，妻子則在情感邊緣徘徊。為挽回尊嚴，他決定自編自導自演一部新作，在海選女主角時被素人深深吸引，從此逐步迷失於戲劇與現實交錯的邊界。當排練成為真實生活的預演，劇場不再是避難所，而是映照內心裂縫的鏡子。首演之夜，一場無法挽回的失控局面即將展開……這部戲中戲作品，以細膩張力探索人性在舞台與生活間的掙扎與救贖，充滿心理深度與情感衝突。

cast: Stephen Fung, Angela Yuen, Myolie Wu, Chrissie Chau
